stretches.name: Standing Quad Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Stand tall and hold onto a wall or chair for balance.
- Bend one knee and grab that ankle behind you.
- Pull the heel gently towards your glutes, keeping the knees together and the hips pushed slightly forward.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat on the floor in front of you.
- Tuck the pelvis under and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
- Shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
- Keep the torso upright; hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Couch Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Kneel with your back to a wall or couch and slide one shin up against it.
- Step the other foot forward into a lunge.
- Slowly raise your torso upright while squeezing the glute of the back leg.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Place one heel on a low step or bench with the leg straight.
- Keep your back flat and hinge forward from the hips.
- Stop when you feel a stretch along the back of the thigh.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Lie on your back with both legs extended.
- Raise one leg, holding behind the thigh or calf (or use a towel around the foot).
- Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and pull the leg gently towards you.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Seated Forward Fold
stretches.instructions:
- Sit with both legs straight out in front of you.
- Lengthen your spine, then hinge forward from the hips.
- Reach towards your feet without forcing it.
- Breathe slowly and relax a little deeper on each exhale.

stretches.name: Wide-Leg Forward Fold
stretches.instructions:
- Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
- Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
- Let your hands rest on the floor or your shins.
- Relax your head and neck, and come up slowly.

stretches.name: Figure-Four Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Lie on your back with both knees bent.
- Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
- Pull the lower leg towards your chest by holding behind the thigh.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Pigeon Pose
stretches.instructions:
- From hands and knees, bring one knee forward behind the same wrist.
- Extend the other leg straight back.
- Square your hips and lower your torso over the front leg as far as is comfortable.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Lie on your back with both legs extended.
- Pull one knee towards your chest with both hands.
- Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Wall Calf Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
- Step one foot back, keeping that leg straight and the heel on the floor.
- Lean into the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Deep Squat Hold
stretches.instructions:
- Stand with your feet a little wider than hip-width.
- Sit down into the deepest squat you can hold with your heels on the floor.
- Use your elbows to gently press the knees outwards.
- Keep your chest up and breathe.

stretches.name: Downward Dog
stretches.instructions:
- Start on hands and knees, then lift your hips up and back.
- Straighten your arms and legs as far as is comfortable to form an inverted V.
- Press your heels towards the floor and your chest towards your thighs.
- Keep breathing slowly.

stretches.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Stand in a doorway and place your forearms on the frame at shoulder height.
- Step one foot forward.
- Lean gently forward until you feel a stretch across the chest.
- Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears.

stretches.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Bring one arm straight across your chest.
- Use the other hand to press it gently towards your body, above the elbow.
- Keep the shoulder down and relaxed.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so the hand drops behind your head.
- Use the other hand to gently push the elbow down and back.
- Keep your head up and your ribs down.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Stand side-on to a wall and place your palm on it slightly behind you, arm straight at shoulder height.
- Slowly turn your body away from the wall.
- Stop when you feel a stretch along the front of the arm.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Child's Pose
stretches.instructions:
- Kneel and sit back on your heels with the knees apart.
- Walk your hands forward and lower your chest towards the floor.
- Reach your arms long and let your forehead rest down.
- Breathe into your back.

stretches.name: Standing Side Bend
stretches.instructions:
- Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
- Raise one arm overhead.
- Lean to the opposite side, reaching up and over without twisting.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Thread the Needle
stretches.instructions:
- Start on hands and knees.
- Slide one arm under your body towards the opposite side, palm up.
- Lower that shoulder and the side of your head towards the floor.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Cobra Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
- Press up slowly, lifting your chest while the hips stay on the floor.
- Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
- Only go as high as your lower back is comfortable.

stretches.name: Supine Spinal Twist
stretches.instructions:
- Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
- Bend one knee and let it fall across your body to the opposite side.
- Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Upper Back Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Clasp your hands in front of you at shoulder height.
- Round your upper back and push your hands away.
- Let your head drop gently between your arms.
- Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades.

stretches.name: Neck Side Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
- Tilt your ear towards one shoulder.
- Optionally rest the hand on that side gently on your head, without pulling.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Extend one arm straight in front of you, palm up.
- Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers down and back.
- Keep the elbow straight.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Extend one arm straight in front of you, palm down.
- Use the other hand to gently bend the wrist down towards you.
- Keep the elbow straight.
- Hold, then switch sides.

stretches.name: Cat-Cow
stretches.instructions:
- Start on hands and knees.
- Inhale as you drop your belly and lift your chest and tailbone.
- Exhale as you round your back and tuck your chin.
- Move slowly with your breath.

stretches.name: Arm Circles
stretches.instructions:
- Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
- Draw small circles, gradually making them bigger.
- Switch direction halfway through.
- Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

stretches.name: Hip Circles
stretches.instructions:
- Stand with your hands on your hips and feet hip-width apart.
- Draw big, slow circles with your hips.
- Switch direction halfway through.
- Keep your upper body still.

stretches.name: Torso Rotations
stretches.instructions:
- Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
- Rotate your upper body from side to side, letting the arms swing.
- Keep your hips facing forward.
- Gradually increase the range of motion.

stretches.name: Leg Swings
stretches.instructions:
- Stand side-on to a wall and hold it for balance.
- Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
- Let the range grow gradually with each swing.
- Then switch sides.

stretches.name: World's Greatest Stretch
stretches.instructions:
- Step into a long lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the front foot.
- Drop the inside elbow towards the front ankle.
- Rotate and reach that same arm up towards the ceiling.
- Return and repeat slowly, then switch sides.

routines.name: Lower Body Cool-Down
routines.description: Five static stretches for the legs and hips after a lower-body workout.

routines.name: Upper Body Cool-Down
routines.description: Chest, shoulders, arms and neck after an upper-body workout.

routines.name: Full Body Stretch
routines.description: About ten minutes of static stretching from head to toe.

routines.name: Morning Mobility
routines.description: Gentle dynamic movements to wake the body up, or as a warm-up.
